positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
State Affairs is a civic tech startup delivering personalized state-level political and legislative news through a mobile-first platform.

Tech Stack: React, React Native, Expo, Redux, Node.js, GraphQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Express.js, AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3), Jest, Cypress, Bitrise, GitHub Actions

- Starting from zero lines of code–spearheaded the full stack development of the State Affairs mobile app from inception to production to bring a full product to iOS/Play stores
- Currently leading a team of 4 Engineers on Mobile, but in general at State Affairs--helping provide technical direction and helping make sure we adhere to quality coding standards, proper test coverage, proper documentation, best practices, etc.
- Building complex UI components involving advanced interactions such as auto-scrolling lists, infinite scroll, pan gestures, swipe controls, synchronized animations, deep linking, and dynamic state-driven rendering to ensure a seamless and responsive user experience
- Main contributor to backend infrastructure as well, worked on tasks such as optimizing database queries and API performance, reducing response times for article retrieval from 1500 ms to an average of 150-250 ms, leveraging indexing, caching strategies, and query optimizations in MongoDB and MySQL.
- Developed a robust push notification system which keeps users up to date with news, bills,
hearings, etc. Included granular support for notification preferences (when and what users
receive). Handling deep linking as well
- Helping drive re-architecture of legacy client-driven cookie-based authentication to a full
server-side session management solution, supporting both password and one time code
logins, rolling expiration, etc. Improving login experience at state affairs
- Contributor to the overall backend infrastructure, implementing GraphQL resolvers,
Express.js middleware, etc. ensuring scalable and maintainable API services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Exo Imaging is a medical device company developing ultrasound imaging hardware and cloud-based software tools for clinicians.

Tech Stack: React, Redux, Django, PostgreSQL, AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECR), Cornerstone, RTK Query, Cypress

- Worked on Exo’s Web Applications, Backend and Cloud Services
- One of the key contributors to ExoWorks - Web software that allows immediate viewing of ultrasound examinations, features documentation and review of exams across a medical organization, allows for instantaneous viewing/editing sharing of exams/ultrasound scans and provides real-time feedback. It also manages the credentialing and QA Program
- Built backend services for web and mobile applications. Developed robust API endpoints using Django. Improved database query efficiency–added prefetching and increasing use of data relationships, reducing query execution time by up to 40%. These endpoints supported both Web and Mobile clients
- Enhanced ExoWorks’ DICOM image-viewer to allow professional grade adjustments to Ultrasound Dicom image files using Cornerstone
- Played key role in implementing and maintaining Exo’s secure session management, ensuring single login sessions per user and enhancing overall application security
- Significantly improved ExoWorks UI performance by adding API response caching via RTK Query
- Lead and deployed a static asset management service using AWS Lambda/API Gateway which handles anonymous uploads/downloads to Amazon S3 buckets
- Helped significantly reduce unexpected regressions by initiating and implementing end-to-end (E2E) testing using Cypress, significantly enhancing the application's reliability
- Orchestrated and maintained various AWS services, including AWS Lambda functions, ECR, API Gateway, and custom Authorizers, helped build/maintain our cloud service’s infrastructure
- Contributed to defining and documenting coding standards, fostering best practices and improving team collaboration

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Pear Therapeutics specialized in prescription digital therapeutics (PDTs) for treating mental health and neurological conditions.

Tech Stack: React, React Native, Node.js, Redux, CodePush, Split.io, Cypress, TestRail, custom event middleware, data visualizations

- Heavy React/React-Native work developing for browsers and mobile devices
- Helped create our web dashboard for healthcare providers to view patient data and insights
- Built/maintained API's that interfaced with various services and databases
- Built complex UI elements for our library of components within Pear -- calendars, drag and drop functionality, complex tables, video players, micro front-ends
- Built middleware that tracked user interaction events, allowed for more accurate data on how our mobile apps were being used
- Built multi-device state sync engine, this enabled a seamless experience when using multiple devices -- added dynamic conflict resolution strategies between data syncs
- Built our notification scheduling system that allowed for unique messages per user based on each user and what they needed
- Implemented a number of our software integrations such as Codepush, Split, Cypress,
integration with TestRail
- Comprehensive testing for all code contributions, Unit testing with Jest/Mocha, React testing with Enzyme, React/native-testing library, E2E tests with Cypress.js and Selenium
- Worked within multiple of Pear’s code bases, ability to learn and implement fixes quickly if we couldn't wait for a library to fix a bug that our product needed
- Develop patches for any out of date libraries to maximize compatibility with our products

Worked on anything needed to make sure our products made it from idea, design, prototyping to final production deployment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ayasdi provided AI-powered data analytics and machine learning solutions for complex problems in healthcare and finance.

Tech Stack: React, Django, Python, D3.js, Backbone.js (legacy), data visualization libraries, internal admin tools

Development:
Heavy work in React/Redux eco system. Implementing end-to-end web applications from build configurations with webpack to UI development to assuring cross-browser compatibility. Creating complex dashboard widgets, data visualizations with d3 such as network layout for Ayasdi's topological data modeling

Web technologies used but not limited to: HTML5/CSS3, Javascript/ES6+, reactjs, redux, momentjs, backbonejs, underscoreJS, jquery, RESTful web services, ajax, node, webpack

Testing:

Alongside development, currently writing unit, integration and end to end testing in various environments for features before they are delivered

Implementing Javascript unit testing with Karma, Jasmine, Enzyme for our React Components

Python testing with Selenium/Splinter and integration with CD/CI tools such as Jenkins/Kubernetes/SauceLabs

Other relevant tasks/skills:
Design (when needed):

Experience with Sketch3, can design with modern UX principles while taking into account for any software limitations. Able to create a workflow/wire-frame of a down to the pixel design behavior of an application or feature.

Bash scripting to automate and speed up the process of onboarding, such as installing local development environments and dependencies.

Experience with Python web frameworks such as Django, working with Python SDK

Constant use of version control with git

positions.title: Web Development
positions.description:
- Javascript development (MVC architecture, Angular2, React, node, express, ajax, nginx, MongoDB, postgreSQL, Webpack, SystemJS,  mongooseJS, ES6/Typescript)

- Testing and automation with Python, Selenium, Mocha, Chai, Enzyme

- Design and test RESTful API with node/express/mongo

- Implement middleware for authentication and protect API calls

- Develop a full web application for an internal technical resource for technicians, making sure functional requirements are met and provide status for project tracking

- Version control using GIT, coordinate with trainers and management to meet an aesthetically pleasing and functional UI/UX 

- Very proficient in PHP/HTML5/CSS3/Javascript, Nginx, Apache Webserver, MySQL

- Confident with using common frameworks and tools such as Redux, Bootstrap, JSON Web Tokens, HTTP handling, axios, lodash

- Solid knowledge of troubleshooting with debugging tools: Firebug, Chrome Developer Console

- Experienced in creating a Custom Management System (CMS)

positions.title: Network Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Knowledge of Networking: TCP/IP, routing, IP Subnetting, DNS, ARP, NAT Rules

- Fluent with scripting languages such as Perl, Bash, PHP, using Regular Expressions

- Fluent in protocols such as SSL/TLS,SPF, FTP, POP3/IMAP, HTTP/HTTPS, SMB/CIFS, etc.

- Role based access control with Active Directory, LDAP, Radius, etc.

- Excellent at Command Line troubleshooting and working in a Linux/UNIX/BSD environment

- Database management, using MySQL/PostgreSQL at the command line level

- Excellent deductive skills to properly troubleshoot a problem whether it be a networking issue or client-server problem, and show clearly with error logs for the proper protocol/application/etc.

- Packet analysis with TCP Dumps

- Virtual deployment knowledge in ESXi, Azure, vSphere

projects.title: EEPROM Circuit using I2CIO
projects.description: Using different IC Chips such as Inverters, 8-bit latches, and a comparator we programmed a 512kb EEPROM and learned how to send, save, and read the data from the EEPROM

projects.title: Designing Common Gate and Common Source Amplifiers
projects.description: By designing a circuit on a simulator (LTSpice IV), we deigned common source and common gate amplifiers.  The main point was to be able to design one on the simulator and afterwards create the physical circuit.  We also had to use programming with Python to interface between the computer and the Power Supply, Function Generator and Oscilloscope so that we could easily control what signals we we wanted to send through the circuit and afterwards read and show transfer functions and bode plots on the computer
